# Blockly 13.2.1

From the npm package `blockly@13.2.1` (Google, Apache License 2.0, `LICENSE` here): the core, the standard blocks,
the Lua generator and the Spanish, Catalan and English messages (`msg/es.js`, `msg/ca.js`, `msg/en.js`), unchanged.
`../../js/main.js` loads those of the editor's language (`../../js/i18n.js`). The editor's own blocks are in
`../../js/blocks.js`.
